page.layout: Two medallion engravings at the top, with their legends around the rims. Below them one column of running text, with a paragraph beginning "BEATRICINA". Gathering signature at the foot right.

main_text.p: PHILIPPVS Maria, obtruncato Ioanne fratre supradi-ćto, armis paternum Mediolanensem inquam ducatum repetit anno mundi 5379. à Christo nato 1417. Callidus hic in bello pacem, in pace bellù poscere visus est. Discendi auidus semper fuit, callidus, sagax, liberalis, in iniuriis relaxandis facillimus, statura procerus, vultu formidabilis, maturo consilio, arte, ac validissimis armis, tyrannos qui suae ditionis ciuitates occupa-rant, è medio sustulit. Recuperauit Comum, Tricium, Bergamum, Brissiam, Placentiam, Laudem, Cremonam quoque subegit. Io. Iacobus M[illegible, ~3 letters]ferrati Marchio, veritus huius potentiam, Vercellas, Alexandriam, Astamque sponte Philippo restituit. Suo praeterea dominio Genuam maritimam vrbem potentissimam adiecit. Genuenses itaque subacti, ac eius subditi, Alphonsum Neapoli, & Io. Nauarrae Reges, & magnum magistrum S. Iacobi Compostellani fratres, cum aliis primoribus supra 100. & equitibus clarissimis vltra 200. praelio nauali ceperūt: quos ad se perductos humanissimè excepit: ac multis donatos muneribus dimisit: cum illorum regnū ac ditionem totam sibi vindicare, aut occupare facile potuerit. Tandem foedissima libidine infaniuit, & mutata fortuna, nulla relicta virili prole, obiit ventris profluuio anno salutis 1447. Vide Paul. Ioui. & Supplem. Chro. lib. 14.

BEATRICINA, antea Facini Canis vxor, iam vetula, nupsit praedicto Philippo, & numerauit dotē aureorū 400000. hanc postea vt suspectam interfecit. Deinde Mariam Amidei Sabaudiae Ducis filiam in coniugem ductam, praeuentus morte, intactam dimisit. Vide autores quos supra.

page.notes: Engravings: left medallion, profile of Philippus Maria Visconti in a cap, legend "PHILIPPVS M.VI" on the right rim and "COM D MLI" (partly reversed, uncertain) on the left rim. Right medallion, profile of Beatrice (Beatrix) in a veil, legend "PHILL.M.D.M.VXOR" on the left rim and "BEATRICINA" on the right rim. Both legends are part of the engraving, not running text. The dark blot over "Mon..." in "Io. Iacobus Mon-ferrati" hides about three letters; "Mon" is the likely reading but was not read. "Placentiam" is partly obscured by the same blot; the word is read as printed. "Recuperauit" and "Tricium" are as printed.
